name: RFP bid NDA, then the RFP pack
description: 25 suppliers each sign the one-signer bid NDA, sent by Bulk Send from the bundle's RFP Bid NDA template. When an NDA is completed, a workflow From an Event (Envelope Completed, template = the RFP Bid NDA) emails that supplier the RFP pack link.
prerequisites: Send the bid NDAs from the bundle's RFP Bid NDA template (Bulk send): the workflow starts only on envelopes from it (the deploy creates the template and writes its new id into the start).
Replace https://example.com/rfp-pack in the workflow's email with the RFP pack link.
The 25 suppliers in the bundle's bulk send list (one row each), sent with Bulk send.
